name: print-social-black-lime-glow-3d-one-day-to-go-countdown-post
title: Glowing 3D One Day to Go Countdown
whatItIs: A stock-vector square post on near-black with a logo at the top, a giant black extruded numeral 1 standing on a lime-lit perspective grid floor with a bright horizon glow, the words 'Day to Go !!!' in white, and two small lime spheres; below it a purple area chart on a dark card.
whatItMeans: A numeral lit like a monolith makes the countdown feel like an arrival, and the lime horizon is the only colour.
techniques: Giant extruded numeral as the hero
Perspective grid floor with a glowing horizon
Black object against a bright glow for a rim effect
Short white caption under the number

vocabulary.definition: A receding grid plane used as a ground.
A bright band of light along a scene's horizon.
